rv.q: Mowgli's departure from the jungle feels like a genuine loss, rounding off a gripping and vigorous show.
There's plenty of fun to be had from the Octagon's colourful Christmas offering.
The Jungle Book at Octagon Theatre Theatre delivers a family-friendly adaptation with humour, heart and a fresh twist on Kipling’s beloved classic.
Overall, I did not feel truly immersed enough to believe that I was watch animals not actors which led to disappointment in the end.

cn.t: This musical adaptation charms with inventive stagecraft and catchy new numbers, though it omits Disney favorites. A spirited, family-friendly take on Kipling's classic that wins praise for its fresh approach.
